entries.subject: fix(web): render correct quotation thumbnails
entries.classificationRationale: The .NET 10 Blazor-native quotation workflow preserves source part selection, thumbnail rendering, active-part switching, and preview state through the protected-main implementation and its browser regression suite.

entries.subject: Add authoritative quotation qualification contract
entries.classificationRationale: The qualification state, receipt, audit, authorization, concurrency, and PostgreSQL persistence contracts are carried by the target-native QuotationService implementation and its reviewed suite.

entries.subject: Add employee qualification workflow
entries.classificationRationale: The employee qualification workflow is implemented in the .NET 10 Blazor Intranet with preserved permissions, localization, validation, concurrency, and service-boundary behavior.

entries.subject: Harden qualification persistence and receipt privacy
entries.classificationRationale: Receipt privacy, durable audit state, idempotency, and PostgreSQL-only persistence hardening are represented by the independently reviewed target implementation and integration tests.

entries.subject: docs(web): design 3D printing pricing integrity release
entries.classificationRationale: The source commit is a design document only; its approved runtime outcomes are represented by the separately migrated pricing commits in this delta.

entries.subject: docs(web): plan 3D printing pricing integrity release
entries.classificationRationale: The source commit is an implementation plan only; source deployment instructions are not copied into the target runtime and the planned behavior is tracked by the following implementation entries.

entries.subject: fix(web): price FDM build profiles from physical inputs
entries.classificationRationale: Physical FDM build-profile inputs and estimates are preserved by the target pricing catalog/engine with matching unit and browser coverage.

entries.subject: fix(web): estimate FDM support from layer overlap
entries.classificationRationale: Layer-overlap support estimation is retained in the target-native worker and pricing flow, with additive/CNC isolation and regression tests preserved.

entries.subject: fix(web): price resin by occupied plates
entries.classificationRationale: Resin occupied-plate pricing and review presentation are represented in the protected target pricing implementation and its full regression suite.

entries.subject: fix(web): seal additive quote prices server-side
entries.classificationRationale: Signed additive quote tickets, server-owned totals, and fulfillment validation are preserved without trusting browser-submitted prices.

entries.subject: fix(web): fail closed on FX and international shipping
entries.classificationRationale: FX, destination, shipping, and minimum-order failure semantics remain fail-closed in the migrated target pricing boundary.

entries.subject: test(web): verify additive pricing integrity release
entries.classificationRationale: The source verification plan and tests are translated into the target .NET 10 test architecture; no incompatible .NET 8 test host or source deployment fixture is copied.

entries.subject: perf(web): keep additive support analysis out of CNC
entries.classificationRationale: Additive support analysis remains isolated from CNC processing in the target worker and browser contracts.

entries.subject: Merge pull request #53 from MALIEV-Co-Ltd/codex/fix-3d-printing-pricing-integrity
entries.classificationRationale: The merge commit has no independent patch; each parent pricing outcome is explicitly mapped to the protected target implementation.

entries.subject: fix(web): describe resin process in quotation review
entries.classificationRationale: The resin process description, review disclosure, and finalized-price behavior are retained by the target quotation review surface.

entries.subject: Merge pull request #54 from MALIEV-Co-Ltd/codex/fix-resin-review-profile
entries.classificationRationale: The merge commit adds no independent behavior beyond the already mapped resin-review parent commit.

entries.subject: fix(web): keep quotation available during country outage
entries.classificationRationale: The target main preserves a renderable quotation page when country lookup is unavailable, keeps CNC thumbnail values in a skeleton state until finalization, and uses the corrected bundled Font Awesome path through the target-native route/assets architecture.

entries.subject: fix: preserve API-owned CNC lead attribution
entries.classificationRationale: The API-owned request and journey identifiers flow through QuotationService into Web attribution without browser reconstruction; both producer and consumer protected-main contracts are merged and tested.

entries.subject: feat: switch site typography to Outfit
entries.classificationRationale: Self-hosted Outfit Latin/Latin-ext assets, generated bundles, English/Thai stacks, and delivery contracts are migrated; source-only Razor deploy scripts and inline font styles are deliberately represented by the target asset-manifest and App.razor architecture.
